name: RecapTV
description: Each Jellyfin user connects their own RecapTV (https://my.recaptv.app) account from their profile menu. On completed playback, the plugin reports the watched item to RecapTV, which adds it to the user's watchlist and marks it watched (with optional backfill of earlier episodes). No server-admin setup beyond installing the plugin is required.
overview: Sync watched movies and episodes from Jellyfin to your RecapTV account.

versions.changelog:
0.1.6
- 🩹 fixed script injection breaking behind reverse proxies/tunnels (nginx, Cloudflare Tunnel) by using a relative URL instead of guessing the base path
- 🐛 fixed a crash on servers with a stale blank API URL saved from before CI set one; production now always trusts the build-time default

- 0.1.5: register client script injection with the File Transformation plugin
  when installed (now required), falling back to request-time middleware
  otherwise
- 0.1.4: fix injection script to use request PathBase instead of hardcoded root path - 0.1.3: replace RecapTV client settings icon with a more appropriate "live_tv" icon, and remove the old SVG icon. - 0.1.2: fix client script injection to use request-time middleware instead of
  rewriting index.html on disk, avoiding permission failures on read-only web
  roots (e.g. some Docker setups).
- 0.1.1: repository restructure, no functional changes. - 0.1.0: initial release - per-user RecapTV connection, playback-complete sync.
